brief:
Journalistic investigations have revealed financial ties between members of President Donald Trump's "Peace Council"—established to oversee post-war arrangements in Gaza—and Israeli companies operating in defense industries, the Shehab Wire reported. The council was created to manage reconstruction and political settlements following the conflict.

The findings expose potential conflicts of interest among officials tasked with shaping Gaza's future, as some council members hold investment stakes in Israeli military-related businesses. Details of specific investments and the extent of financial involvement remain under scrutiny.
